teaser: A sink full of glasses waits by the end of the night, and you are the one who starts washing them before anyone asks. Life path 9 asks for letting go of what no longer belongs to you, and an INFJ already notices who at the party is standing alone before they say a word. Crossed, the two make care into something automatic — you fill the gap nobody named, and rarely tally what it cost. What is particular here is a generosity that doubles as distance: close to the cause, far from the want underneath it.
